route_status: SEPARATE SOURCE-VERSION RETRY following v0 fail-closed: CI39218182379 all six source HOLD because original raw Open-Meteo API JSON SHA256s changed. Six original GPS cohort animal counts and matched-date group movement & mean regional ERA5 climate outputs were reproduced exactly BEFORE raw SHA gate. No six new pairwise Spearman values opened in v0.
diagnosis: Open-Meteo ERA5 original JSON body contains generationtime_ms which differs between multiple independently repeated requests to exactly the same public URL; initial diagnostic saw e.g. 2.084970474243164 and 2.16829776763916 with identical first/last sampled daily temperatures and full 287-day date coverage. A full raw-body checksum therefore does not reliably identify scientific weather-content revisions.
scientific_effect_status: Unchanged v0 date list, individual roster, 6 original GPS effect means and day/night response. Unchanged v0 new rank Spearman endpoints, exclusion rules, six-cohort source sampling and source source terms. This is a source-integrity repair BEFORE v1 pairwise rho inspection, NOT a retune of animal analysis.
source_contract: Exactly original Open-Meteo historical ERA5 source provider model, locations, timezone, source URL query, three daily numeric variables: temperature_2m_mean,precipitation_sum,et0_fao_evapotranspiration, and source date grid/elevation/unit metadata. No alternate weather product, region, imputation or variable choice.

canonicality.stable_payload: Parse official response into ordered source daily date + three numeric vectors and source units/location/timezone/elevation; remove ONLY response generationtime_ms from canonical JSON; sorted-key compact JSON SHA256, retained with the full source response receipt. Never remove climate dates or numeric values.
canonicality.validate_units: daily mean temperature °C, precipitation mm, FAO reference evapotranspiration mm; all 3 arrays same full consecutive local calendar source range; no null/nonfinite; negative precipitation/ET0 source HOLD.
canonicality.validate_site: provider output coordinate within 0.5° of original public regional reference, source response timezone original fixed mean standard offset from longitude, never actual animal GPS points.
canonicality.numeric_old_first_run_guard: Even though v0 raw-body SHA differs, original accepted n animals, source movement mean, source mean matched-day ΔT, source mean matched-day Δ30d P−ET0 and missing-date count MUST match first pre-v1 published numeric source receipts to 1e−10, or HOLD.
canonicality.canonical_source_version_limit: Original first run did not retain all original daily arrays, only original raw-response SHA and aggregate climate means. Thus byte-for-byte equivalence of all historical numeric daily values to v0 cannot be proved retrospectively; publish v1 canonical daily data SHA and optionally full public coarse daily arrays in an artifact, WITHOUT relabelling the original v0 raw SHA as passing.
canonicality.avoid_source_instability: Do not assert repeated API responses byte-identical. Keep original failed v0 result unchanged, disclose v1 canonical source SHA, API request URL, new numeric checks and any error.

sampling_lock.test: Re-run old v0 pure tests AND test v1 source body canonicalization against two envelopes with different generationtime_ms; reject daily change, date gaps, wrong unit or different location
sampling_lock.response: For original marked animal×year n>=10 GPS source date-pairs and >=80% weather completeness, with >=8 finite pairs and 4 distinct values, report tie-aware Spearman rho between fixed paired NIGHT–DAY relative GPS displacement and original same-date regional ΔT or previous-30-day Δ(P−ET0). Then equal-year mean within animal, equal animal weights in each of six original cohorts.
sampling_lock.scope: All six original sources, all undefined, no source response-related selection, no p-values, no animal GPS identifiers or raw locations output.

claim_ceiling: Purely descriptive within-cohort climate–GPS co-trends. Animals share same regional ERA5 calendar and different species/geographies/collars; this does NOT prove causal heat sensitivity, species traits, or universal photoperiod memory. It is a robust rank-based sensitivity after earlier OLS slope results, not a new confirmatory animal hypothesis.
